additional_info.subject: RE: ID0476510-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / NN 170000049] OCPP Fault CRM:02888000574
additional_info.body:
Dear Milan,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0476510.
I was handed over the ticket this week and took some time to analyze this complex case.
Let me start by saying that I agree with your analysis shared in the Loginterpretation file:
I checked on AWS, and this behavior happened 18 times between January and February.
The behavior is systematic, and I believe it is a combination of different issues:
The charger sends the StartTransaction when entering in P06.
Systematically, we do not receive a response from the Backend, and the connection to the Backend drops off.
In my opinion, this could be generated by the Backend and not by the charger.
After this, it starts what I believe the incorrect behavior of our charger:
Once the connection is re-established, we send again the start transaction and we receive the confirmation.
Then we send the StopTransaction which includes the reason "PowerLoss". I checked on the OCPP 1.6 protocol, and the reason "PowerLoss" it is mentioned only in reference to a loss of power from the charger, while it seems we use it as if in relation with the loss of communication.
Also, we do not increase the metervalues, even though we have a clear energy transfer.
I checked several sessions, and always found the same pattern. I believe the questions now are:
Why the connection to the Backend always drops after sending the StartTransaction and if this is a fault of the Backend.
Why we send another StartTransaction
Why we give as a reason to stop the "PowerLoss"
Why we do not increase the meter values.
I am creating now a R&D ticket and escalate the issue to them. I will inform you as soon as I have updates.
In your opening email you stated that this behavior is happening only on this charger. Could you please confirm if no other charger is experiencing this?
Many thanks in advance for your feedback.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei

expected release CW15).
